integrity: Exact algebraic proof and independently replayable finite tests. Scientific priority is provisional: relevant sections of recent primary sources were inspected, but specialized historical work and inaccessible remainder of the newest source pose residual risks.
limitations: Only a fixed two-dimensional search plane in real ambient dimension three, two independent standard Gaussian sketch rows, exact arithmetic, and one extraction; no bound for larger dimensions or iterative algorithms.
title: A sharp \(1-\sqrt{2/3}\) complex-pair bound for minimally sketched symmetric Ritz matrices
